recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量前骨髓球與骨髓球，胞質含粗大深紫色顆粒、核旁有淡染 Golgi 區，後段成熟細胞少，屬左移並伴毒性顆粒的反應性變化；此視野未見神經母細胞瘤腫瘤細胞。
features: Predominance of promyelocytes and myelocytes with abundant cytoplasm
Coarse, dark purple azurophilic granules throughout the cytoplasm, consistent with toxic-type granulation
Round to oval eccentric nuclei with fine to slightly condensed chromatin and perinuclear Golgi clearing
Occasional erythroblasts and few mature neutrophils; no Auer rods
No cohesive clusters of small round blue tumor cells in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows left-shifted granulopoiesis composed mainly of promyelocytes and myelocytes with coarse, darkly staining azurophilic granules and prominent Golgi zones. Mature neutrophils are relatively few, and occasional erythroid precursors are present. No Auer rods or clusters of metastatic tumor cells are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with reactive left-shifted myelopoiesis with toxic granulation; although the case is filed under metastatic neuroblastoma, tumor cells are not seen in this image and other fields/biopsy should be assessed.

ddx.vs: APL cells have bilobed or folded nuclei without a Golgi hof, may contain Auer rod bundles, and do not show maturation beyond the promyelocyte stage.
Morphology overlaps completely, so the distinction rests on clinical history of chemotherapy or growth factor administration.
Neuroblastoma appears as cohesive clusters or rosettes of small round cells with scant cytoplasm and neuropil, which are not present in this field.
